name: Le Méridien Pasadena Arcadia
positioning: Mid-century modern hotel in Arcadia, in the heart of the San Gabriel Valley, with equestrian-inspired interiors and curated art
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led base near Pasadena and Santa Anita Park
Guests who enjoy an afternoon high tea with cocktail pairings

facts.text: Le Méridien Pasadena Arcadia is a mid-century modern hotel.
The hotel is in Arcadia, in the heart of the San Gabriel Valley.
The LA County Arboretum, Westfield Santa Anita and downtown Pasadena are all minutes away.
Rooms are mid-century modern and stocked with Malin + Goetz amenities.
Bathrooms are marble and come with robes.
Beds have cotton-rich linens and pillow-top mattresses.
The hotel has an outdoor pool.
The hotel has a fitness center.
Mélange, the on-site restaurant, serves New American cuisine.
Longitude 118 is an upscale bar offering craft brews, wine, cocktails and a global food menu.
The LA Metro Rail Arcadia Station on the Gold line is listed as a nearby station.

highlights.text: The interiors are equestrian-inspired, influenced by nearby Santa Anita Park Racetrack.
Guests can wake up to views of the San Gabriel Mountains.
The hotel features curated global art installations.
High Tea & High Balls reimagines classic high tea with bespoke highball cocktail pairings and tea-infused cocktails.

considerations.text: The hotel does not offer self parking; valet service is available.
The hotel's address is 130 West Huntington Drive in Arcadia, not central Pasadena; downtown Pasadena is minutes away.
WhataHotel notes the suburban location requires transportation to downtown LA.
